why: The regression net derives what it drives FROM THE MANIFEST. `format_arm` uses a collapsed caret because that is the only gesture set-bold was offered for, and the runner says so in its own comment. So an action that is UNDER-offered is invisible to every check at once: the manifest narrows, the harness narrows with it, and the two agree forever. Finding 078 is what that costs -- the operator selected text, pressed bold, and got a refusal, while 38 checks were green. This file is the expectation kept OUTSIDE the manifest, so the two can disagree.
howToUse: check_gesture_offers.py compares the shipped profile's action map against `expected`. A narrowing is a FAILURE here even when every other check is green, and a widening is a failure too -- an action offered for a gesture nobody characterised is the defect this project's contract exists to prevent, in the other direction.
changing: Never edit `expected` to make this pass. Either the manifest is wrong, or a measurement has been taken and BOTH move together, with the evidence named in `rationale`.

rationale.set-bold: range-single characterised 2026-08-23, all four inline formats, findings/evidence/f078-inline-format-on-a-selection/. range-cross measured equal too but expresses a fully selected paragraph as paragraph-level formatting and reports a 5-character list prefix in the selection text; neither is explained, so it stays withheld.
rationale.select-all: shipped dark: present in the manifest with an EMPTY gesture list, which is what withholding means here. Omitting it would ship it wide open, because the engine initialises every action to all-permitted and intersects from there.
rationale.delete-selection: range only by nature; a collapsed caret has nothing to delete.
